validation.candidate06_gpu_evidence_scope: Historical candidate06 evidence remains in the previous manifest. It is not relabeled as validation of candidate07.

retained_failures.scope: First source attempt used copy initialization for an explicit LocalVector copy constructor. Repaired with direct initialization; no API or synchronization semantic change. This attempt produced no tested executable.

A truly empty cwd lacked required cwd/tests/data. Main::test_setup failed before any case and ThemeDB teardown crashed. Same binary passed all 10 cases after only copying official tests/data to an isolated cwd and isolating APPDATA/TEMP/TMP.

limitations: Functional GPU contracts passed on recorded project snapshots; ordinary game retains exactly the 74 existing candidate06 glTF stride warnings. No new ordinary-game diagnostic.
Native CPU contracts use real StreamedTexture2D subclasses and existing worker queues under the dummy renderer, with controlled registration/reload and synthetic feedback completion.

Observation demand belongs to the whole marked feedback-buffer period, not one viewport. Covered no-demand rows are terminal ready independent of unrelated I/O; positive-demand rows require fitted residency and unchanged versions after project redraw.
Reload completion and queued render texture replacement are different boundaries; the project must redraw, await after_drawn, requery versions and then capture.
No LOD/budget/I/O-rate overrides, global streaming flush, main-thread worker join or new thread were added by the observation API.
Source replay is byte-exact for 49 affected files. Rebuilding with different paths, toolchains or timestamps need not produce identical executable/symbol bytes.
No whole-map loading, FPS, 1% low or physical RSS/VRAM claim is made.
